2609.13062.title: Anchoring Clinical Events in Time: UID-Preserving Multimodal Reconstruction and Source-Grounded Adjudication
2609.13062.paper_summary: Clinical timelines support treatment-window analysis and leakage-free modeling, but discharge summaries often obscure chronology and structured EHR tables describe only part of the patient course. We present a UID-preserving framework that links each narrative event occurrence to its source span and retains that identity through text-only estimation, structured-evidence retrieval, timestamped source-row grounding, and joint revision. We also present GAVEL, an LLM judge that compares two UID-aligned timelines against the narrative and structured record, to augment prior matching and temporal assessments. Across six open-weight models and 40 mixed-critical-care summaries, the GLM 5.2 multimodal revision, as compared to its text-only variant, improved temporal agreement without reducing event recovery and performed competitively with clinician annotations, while other model revisions showed smaller gains and lower overall performance. Ablations showed that UIDs primarily preserve event retention, whereas source-row linkage supports temporal placement. Blinded human review upheld most GAVEL findings, and controlled adjudication favored multimodal over text-only GLM 5.2 but did not for DeepSeek V3.2. In developing the UID and judge pipeline, we are able to demonstrate 43\% increased event recovery, a framework competitive with clinician annotations, and a system with occurrence-level provenance for both reconstruction and evaluation.
2609.13062.paper_summary_zh: 臨床時間線支持治療窗口分析和無洩漏建模，但出院摘要常常模糊時間順序，結構化的電子健康紀錄表格僅描述患者過程的一部分。我們提出了一個保留UID的框架，將每個敘事事件的發生與其來源範圍連結，並通過僅文本估算、結構證據檢索、帶時間戳的來源行基礎和聯合修訂來保持該身份。我們還介紹了GAVEL，一個LLM評判者，將兩個UID對齊的時間線與敘事和結構記錄進行比較，以增強先前的匹配和時間評估。在六個開放權重模型和40個混合重症護理摘要中，與其僅文本變體相比，GLM 5.2多模態修訂改善了時間一致性，而不降低事件恢復，並且在與臨床醫生註釋的比較中表現出競爭力，而其他模型修訂則顯示出較小的增益和較低的整體表現。消融實驗顯示，UID主要保留事件的保留，而來源行連結支持時間的放置。盲審人類評審支持了大多數GAVEL的發現，控制裁決則偏向於多模態而非僅文本的GLM 5.2，但對於DeepSeek V3.2則不然。在開發UID和評判者管道的過程中，我們能夠展示43\%的事件恢復增長，這是一個與臨床醫生註釋具有競爭力的框架，以及一個對重建和評估都具有事件級來源的系統。
